basic_details.job_title: DGFT Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 9 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The 9 Consultant posts in DGFT Mumbai Recruitment 2026 are open only to retired Central Government officers. Applicants must have retired as Assistant Section Officer, Section Officer or Under Secretary to the Government of India, or an equivalent rank. The Office of the Additional Director General of Foreign Trade, Mumbai is an attached office of the Department of Commerce, Ministry of Commerce and Industry. Its Vacancy Circular F.NO.75/02/2022-2025/HRD, dated 16 October 2026, offers a contract that starts at one year. The remuneration is Last Pay Drawn minus pension plus TA drawn at the time

how_to_apply: Fill in the application form printed with the circular ("Application for the post of Consultant on contract basis"). It asks for your name, date of birth, email, mobile number, address, educational qualification, date of superannuation, organisation retired from, post held at retirement, age as on the closing date (YY/MM), PPO number, PAN, Aadhaar number, departmental exams qualified, current organisation if any, details of your experience, and your knowledge of MS Office tools.
Paste your photograph in the space given on the form.

Sign the undertaking with the place and date. In it you declare that the particulars are true, that you were clear from the vigilance angle at retirement, and that you accept the terms of the circular. You also agree to give references for assignments done in the last three years.
Attach the documents named in the notice (listed below).
Email the application to [email protected] by 5 November 2026.
You may also send a hard copy to: Deputy DGFT(HRD), O/o Addl.DGFT, Nishtha Bhavan, 48, Sir Vithaldas Thackersey Marg, Churchgate, Mumbai - 400020.
Incomplete applications and applications received after the due date will be rejected. If your experience details do not fit on the form, you may annex a separate sheet.
important_instructions: During the contract period, the Consultant may not accept any other assignment or consultancy of any type. The Consultant must maintain absolute confidentiality of the information they handle, both during the contract and after it ends. Failing this, they are liable for suitable action. The Official Secrets Act, 1923 applies to the Consultant. The Consultant must maintain the highest standards of integrity, transparency, competitiveness, economy and efficiency. Attendance is marked in the Aadhaar-enabled Biometric Attendance System. DGFT reserves the right to end the engagement at any stage for serious failure to perform assigned tasks or failure to observe standards of conduct. Either side may end it with one month's notice or pay in lieu of notice. DGFT reserves the right to accept or reject, in part or full, any or all responses without giving reasons. The decision of the Selection Committee will be final and binding on all applicants.

content_sections.heading: About DGFT Mumbai
content_sections.text: The Office of the Additional Director General of Foreign Trade (O/o Addl.DGFT) is an attached office of the Department of Commerce, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India. The office is at Nishtha Bhavan, 48, Sir Vithaldas Thackersey Marg, Churchgate, Mumbai - 400020. Its telephone numbers are 22038094/22017716/22033097/22031074/22066300. The circular is issued by its Administration HRD section.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The circular invites applications only from retired Government Officers/Officials. An applicant must meet all of the following: Retired rank: retired from the rank of Assistant Section Officer/Section Officer to the Government of India or equivalent/Under Secretary to the Government of India or equivalent, from Central Government Ministries/Departments or their attached/subordinate offices. Experience: substantive secretariat experience (noting/drafting/typing) in areas such as monitoring/implementation of policies/schemes, disbursal/allocation of funds, budget/accounts, establishment and cash. Computer skills: fully conversant with MS-Word/PPT/Excel etc. as the role requires, and able to print their own notes/drafts/OMs as required. Age and health: should not have attained the age of 64 years on the closing date of applications (5 November 2026), and should be in good health to discharge official duties effectively. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The application form does ask for the applicant's educational qualification, any departmental exam qualified, and their knowledge or experience of MS Office tools. In the form's undertaking, the applicant must also declare that they were clear from the vigilance angle at the time of retirement. For the full eligibility conditions of the Consultant post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Consultants are paid under Department of Expenditure OM No. 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09.12.2020. Under this OM, the remuneration is the Last Pay Drawn minus pension, plus the TA drawn at the time of retirement. No D.A. component is involved. The engagement is initially for one year from the date of joining. The Competent Authority may extend or curtail it at its discretion. Normal working hours are 9.30 am to 6.00 pm. In exigencies, a Consultant may be called on holidays or beyond normal hours, and no extra compensation is admissible for this. Paid leave may be allowed at 1.5 days for each completed month of service. Leave cannot be accumulated beyond a calendar year, and 'No work no pay' applies to leave taken beyond the prescribed limit.

content_sections.heading: DGFT Mumbai Consultant Job Description
content_sections.text: Examine cases/proposals and policy issues in the light of Central Government rules and regulations. Prepare briefs/presentations. Analyse proposals assigned by their controlling officers.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DGFT Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 9 (Nine) Consultant vacancies on contract basis in the O/o Addl.DGFT, Mumbai.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the DGFT Mumbai Consultant post?
faq.answer: Applications must reach [email protected] by 5 November 2026. Applications received after the due date will be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the DGFT Mumbai Consultant post?
faq.answer: Only retired officers can apply. They must have retired as Assistant Section Officer/Section Officer or Under Secretary to the Government of India (or equivalent) from Central Government Ministries/Departments or their attached/subordinate offices. They also need substantive secretariat experience and must be conversant with MS-Word/PPT/Excel.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the DGFT Mumbai Consultant post?
faq.answer: The applicant should not have attained the age of 64 years on the closing date of applications, which is 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. How is the pay of a retired officer fixed as a DGFT Mumbai Consultant?
faq.answer: The pay follows Department of Expenditure OM No. 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09.12.2020. It is the Last Pay Drawn minus pension, plus the TA drawn at the time of retirement. No D.A. component is involved.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the DGFT Mumbai Consultant post?
faq.answer: Email the filled application form to [email protected] with copies of your PPO, last salary slip and Aadhaar card by 5 November 2026. You may also post a hard copy to Deputy DGFT(HRD), O/o Addl.DGFT, Nishtha Bhavan, 48, Sir Vithaldas Thackersey Marg, Churchgate, Mumbai - 400020.

faq.question: Q7. Is the DGFT Mumbai Consultant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a contract engagement, initially for one year from the date of joining. The Competent Authority may extend or curtail it at its discretion.

faq.question: Q8. What are the working hours and leave for a DGFT Mumbai Consultant?
faq.answer: Normal working hours are 9.30 am to 6.00 pm, and attendance is marked biometrically. Paid leave may be allowed at 1.5 days per completed month, with no accumulation beyond a calendar year.

faq.question: Q9. Can a DGFT Mumbai Consultant take up another assignment during the contract?
faq.answer: No. During the contract period, the Consultant may not accept any other assignment or consultancy of any type.
